input.brief: Pinaakini Infra, Nellore developer named after the Pinakini (Penna) river; flagship AVARIA pool villa filmed at dusk

direction.name: The place carries it
direction.idea: For a place, the photograph is the argument. One full-bleed image of where you would be standing fills the first screen, and the design steps back: the name sits along the bottom edge like a film title, or small in a corner, and nothing else interrupts the view. The page that follows keeps that restraint: few words, large pictures, long pauses. The designer's work here is editing: choosing the one frame that makes someone want to be there, and then not covering it.
direction.composition: First screen: a single photograph at 100vw by 100svh, focal point kept clear of text. The name is set either very large (14–20vw) hugging the bottom edge with 16–24px of margin, or small (20–28px) top-left with a one-line description bottom-left. Navigation is two to four words in the top corners in the same small size. If text sits on the image, a soft neutral scrim under the text area only. Below, sections alternate between a short centred or left-set paragraph in a narrow column (max 52ch) with wide empty margins, and photographs shown large: one full-bleed, then a pair at different sizes, then one portrait offset to the right. Practical information (hours, address, rates, booking) is gathered once near the end in a plain two-column block.
direction.typography: A face with some grace for the name; small, calm, well-spaced text everywhere else. Sentence case. Body 17–19px with leading around 1.55.
direction.colour: Neutral paper or deep neutral ground chosen to flatter the photographs; text ink drawn from the darkest tone in the imagery. Colour lives in the pictures.
direction.imagery: The dealt set is the palette. Choose four to six photographs with the same light. The hero image must have a calm area for the name. Full-bleed or large with square corners; never thumbnails, never a carousel of ten.
direction.photoTreatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.
direction.richness: The photographs, at full size, uninterrupted. Empty paper around short text makes the next image land harder.
direction.pitfalls: A weak hero photograph cannot be fixed by typography; pick again. Do not stack a headline, a paragraph and two buttons on the image. Do not use a booking bar that covers the bottom of the view; one small action is enough.

hero.name: Film title, bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One photograph fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, with its subject in the upper two-thirds and a calmer, darker zone along the bottom. The name is one condensed uppercase word, or a short name in a high-contrast serif, set at clamp(150px, 17.5vw, 290px) and sized to span the full width between 32px margins. It is centred and anchored so its baseline sits 34px above the bottom edge, covering roughly the lowest quarter of the frame. A soft neutral dark scrim lies under that bottom band only, about 40% of the height; the rest of the image is untouched. Directly above the name's left end, on the same margin, sits the supporting sentence at 16px on two short lines. Directly above its right end, right-aligned, sits the single action as a small paper-coloured rectangular button. The top edge carries a small emblem or wordmark at the left margin and up to five text links at 15px grouped at the right, all in white. The central half of the screen belongs to the view.
hero.mobile: The photograph is re-cropped to portrait with `object-position` on its subject and fills 100svh. The name stays on the bottom edge at 22vw on one line, or two lines at 20vw beyond eight characters, 20px above the edge. The supporting sentence sits above the name's left end at 15px. The action button moves to the top-right corner and the links collapse to a menu word beside the emblem.
hero.headline: The name of the place: one word of up to about 12 characters at 17.5vw, or two words stacked on a phone.

type.note: One news serif with optical sizes: light and very tight when huge, open and bookish at 18px. Suits long-form stories, culture pieces, journals and research write-ups.

palette.name: Navy on white
palette.note: Pure white pages with navy type sit between full-bleed photographs, opening on near-black and closing on a warm grey footer. Tangerine is one small tab or button, never larger than a thumbnail.

photos.title: Architecture
photos.note: structure, lines, bridges, facades and building interiors
photos.treatment: Leave photographs ungraded. If text overlays one, darken only the area behind the text with a neutral scrim.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Heading captions a panorama
sections.blueprint: The section is exactly 100svh. Its top third holds a two-line heading of three to six words at clamp(48px, 6.5vw, 96px) with leading 0.95, either centred or flush left on the page margin. 28px beneath the heading sit two small captions side by side, each two lines at 13px and 150px wide with a 48px gap, aligned to the heading (centred as a pair, or both starting at its left edge). 40px below them a full-bleed photograph begins and runs off the bottom of the viewport: it is 100vw wide at 21:9 or wider, and only its top 55–60svh is visible before the fold, the rest arriving with scroll. The heading therefore reads as a large caption to the picture. On an object-led page the image is the object on a flat dark panel inset by the page margin instead of bleeding to the edges.
sections.mobile: Heading at 12vw on two lines, left-aligned, taking the top 30% of the screen. The two captions merge into one four-line block at 14px. The photograph begins at 45% of the screen height in a 4:5 crop, full-bleed, and runs off the bottom.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: Staggered pairs in empty ground
sections.blueprint: No heading. Photographs are placed one or two per screen so that more than half of every screen stays empty ground. Screen one: a 3:4 portrait in columns 1–4 against the left margin, and a near-square 5:4 image in columns 7–12 against the right margin whose top edge starts 30vh lower than the portrait's. Screen two: a 3:2 landscape in columns 6–11 and, 24vh lower, a small 4:5 image in columns 2–4. Repeat the two arrangements, mirrored on the second pass, for six to ten photographs. Under each image's left corner, a one-line caption at 13px in the soft ink, 10px below the image. Vertical gaps between pairs are 22–28vh. Every edge sits on a column line and offsets come from only two values. Square corners. If motion is used, images enter with a short `clip-path` wipe from the bottom edge.
sections.mobile: A single column in which widths and sides alternate: 70% against the left margin, 84% against the right, 56% left, then 100% full-bleed, with 64px between images. Captions sit under each image's left corner at 13px. Portrait crops are preferred so each image fills most of the screen height.

sections.name: Full panels, one midline row
sections.blueprint: Four to seven consecutive panels, each 100vw by 100svh, butted together with no gap. Each panel is one photograph of the project cropped much tighter than its frame (`object-fit: cover` with the image scaled to 130%), so a detail fills the screen. The same three-part text row sits at exactly 50% of the height on every panel, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` or over a neutral dark scrim band 90px tall: the date or year at the left margin at 15px, the project title in capitals at clamp(22px, 2vw, 30px) starting 10% in from the left, and one fact (location, client, number of pieces) at the right margin at 15px. Because the row never moves, scrolling reads like turning plates in a book. Panels may be `position: sticky; top: 0` so each slides over the last. There is no section heading; the first panel's title row is the heading.
sections.mobile: Panels are 100vw by 82svh. The row drops to the bottom of each panel, 20px above its edge: the title at 22px on the first line, then date at the left and fact at the right on a second line at 13px, over the same scrim band.

sections.name: Visit card on a photograph
sections.blueprint: A full-bleed photograph of the place, 100vw by 100svh, carries one solid card and nothing else. The card is a filled panel in the paper colour, fully opaque, 380px wide with 8px corners and 32px padding, placed in the upper-right corner 60px from the top and right edges (or the upper-left: pick the corner where the photograph is calmest). It holds, top to bottom: a two- or three-word title at 28px in a light weight; the address on two lines at 16px; the opening hours as three rows with days at the left and times right-aligned in tabular figures; the phone number; then, flush with the card's bottom edge and spanning its width, a solid booking button 52px tall. The card may be `position: sticky; top: 60px` inside a taller section so it holds while the photograph scrolls beneath it. The photograph's focal point must stay clear of the card. No heading outside the card.
sections.mobile: The photograph is 100vw by 70svh. The card leaves the corner: it spans the width with 16px margins and overlaps the photograph's bottom edge by 80px, so image and card interlock. The booking button is full width, 56px tall, at the card's bottom.

sections.name: Questions beside a tall photograph
sections.blueprint: One field in a deep or pale flat tone, split 5 to 7. Left, columns 1–5: a heading of two to four words at 36–44px; under it the three or four practical facts people ask first (address, times, how to arrive) as plain lines at 18px; then five or six questions as an accordion with no lines between rows, only 28px of space. Each question is a `<summary>` at 20px with a small chevron drawn from two 2px strokes at its right; the open answer sits beneath at 17px in the softer ink, on the same left edge. One filled button and one text link close the column. Right, columns 7–12: a tall photograph (3:4) that bleeds off the top edge of the section and stops 80px short of the bottom, with a second, square photograph a third of its width overlapping its lower-left corner by 40px.
sections.mobile: The tall photograph leads at full width, 4:5, with the square one overlapping its bottom-right corner at 38% width. Heading at 30px, facts at 17px, then the accordion at full width with 24px between questions and 44px touch targets. Button full width at the end.

sections.name: The back of the card
sections.blueprint: The footer is the reverse side of the page's artefact, laid out as the back of a postcard. A paper-coloured panel spans columns 2–11 on the contrasting ground, about 420px tall, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops (an inline SVG path or `clip-path`, each scallop about 100px wide). The panel is divided by space into two halves. Left half: a short sign-off of two to four words at 32px, then two or three lines at 16px, written like a message. Right half: the address block, four left-aligned lines at 18px with 12px between them, each line a link (email, telephone, street, social); above it in the top-right corner, a stamp: one small photograph, 3:4 and 88px wide, with a 6px paper-coloured margin. Along the panel's bottom edge, a single centred line at 12px gives the copyright like a printer's imprint.
sections.mobile: The panel runs full width with six scallops across its top edge. The stamp sits top-right at 64px wide; the sign-off and message come first, then the address lines at 17px beneath them, then the imprint line centred at 12px.

references.name: White Desert
references.idea: One word, the destination, set a third of the screen tall over footage like a film title card; sheer scale stands in for remoteness.
references.hero: Full-bleed video (the view from an aircraft window over an ice shelf, darkly vignetted by the window frame) fills the viewport. Faint vertical hairlines divide it into six columns. Top-left, three outlined rectangular nav buttons about 120 by 40px with 6px gaps; top-right, two more; between them a small white mountain logo over a condensed caps name. One condensed uppercase word spans almost the full width at 17.8vw, white, centred, anchored so its baseline sits about 35px above the bottom edge. At mid-height a two-line italic serif tagline at about 16px hangs on the first column line at left, and a film-play label sits between two hairlines at right.
references.type: Three voices: Oswald 400 uppercase for the giant word and footer wordmark (up to 22vw); Cardinal Classic Long, a light high-contrast serif, for caps statements near 32px and italic taglines; Inter Tight 14px for nav and body. Body to display is roughly an 18x jump.
references.colour: #040608 #ffffff #e9e7e1 #1f2b4d #f5821f #95979a — Footage and near-black open the page; content sections flip to pure white with navy serif type and end on a warm grey footer. One small orange tab is the only accent. Cool overall.
references.imagery: Aerial and wildlife footage and stills of ice, penguins and rust-coloured rock peaks, natural cool grade, always full-bleed with square corners; trips appear as tall vertical image slices set side by side with no gaps.
references.layout: A six-column grid made visible by faint full-height hairlines runs through every section. Text blocks are small and hung off column lines, often starting at column two or three, with large voids around them. Full-bleed image screens alternate with nearly empty white text screens.

sections.description: A white screen with the six vertical hairlines still showing. A serif caps paragraph at about 32px, navy, light weight and tight leading, occupies only columns two to four, left-aligned with its first line indented by half the measure. Above its top-left sits a small italic label ringed by a loose hand-drawn pen scribble. An orange vertical tab with rotated text is fixed to the right edge.

Leaving the hero, the giant word blurs and dissolves into white mist that becomes the next section's background. Later a full-viewport photograph of jagged rock peaks in snow bleeds to all four edges, with a narrow 13px paragraph from the white section above overlapping its top edge at a column line, so text and image interlock rather than stack.

A serif caps heading at about 40px sits left of centre with a long pencil-like scribble underline that extends well past the words on both sides. Below, a full-width band of four vertical image panels with no gaps and unequal widths, like an accordion; the first panel carries a two-line italic serif title in white at its top-left.

Warm grey field. The top row holds a small logo, three columns of grey link lists with italic serif group headings and, at right, a stack of square-cornered off-white tiles (a video thumbnail, two half-width buttons, one full-width). Beneath, the brand name in navy condensed caps runs edge to edge at about 22vw. A final strip has award badges left, a centred italic quotation and legal links right.

steal: Set a single place name in condensed caps at about 18vw, centred and anchored to the bottom edge of full-bleed footage, with everything else on screen at 14-16px.
Leave the column grid visible as faint full-height hairlines across video, white and footer sections, and hang small text blocks off those lines.
Ring or underline small serif labels with a loose hand-drawn pen scribble to put one human mark into an otherwise strict layout.

references.name: Eagle’s Nest
references.idea: Let the lake view do the selling: full-bleed footage of the volcano horizon with the name set as a monumental cream serif along the bottom edge.
references.hero: Full-bleed video of a silhouetted figure meditating before a lake and volcanoes, with no scrim. The name is set in a high-contrast cream serif, uppercase, about 15vw, spanning the full width between 34px margins and sitting on the bottom edge so it covers the lower fifth of the frame. Directly above its left and right ends sit two pairs of small white labels (what it is, where it is). Top row: a round emblem far left, eight plain text links grouped right of centre and an outlined pill button far right. A small black vertical awards tab hangs on the right edge.
references.type: PP Pangaia medium: uppercase at 216px for the wordmark, mixed case with uncial-flavoured alternates for section titles. PP Neue Montreal for nav and body at 16px, with a lead paragraph near 22px. Two faces and about four sizes.
references.colour: #fffae7 #0e2404 #3f6f8c #2d5c8a #5d9aa3 #040303 — Photography supplies lake blues and timber browns. Content sits on warm cream with deep green or lake-blue serif headings, and the footer inverts to very dark forest green with cream type.
references.imagery: Wide landscape video and saturated photos of the lake, bamboo structures and yoga; full-bleed for scene-setters, otherwise inset cards with a small radius. A flat teal vector map of Central America sits beside the main photo.
references.layout: Thirty screens alternating pinned full-bleed photographs with cream content bands. Tight 17-34px outer margins; content is left-anchored with images running to the right margin, and value chapters use centred titles. The recurring serif holds the long page together.

sections.description: A cream band slides up over the hero. A dark green serif heading at about 4vw sits top-left, followed by a three-line lead paragraph near 22px across half the width. Below, a wide landscape photo card takes about 70% of the width with a short white paragraph overlaid in its top-right corner. To its right is a narrower teal map card with one location dot, and beneath it four tiny label and value pairs, including live local time.

A large blue serif title centred on cream shrinks into a small centred label pinned just above a full-bleed photograph. The photo stays fixed while single value words appear one at a time at its centre in white serif at about 4vw, each with two lines of small centred text beneath. One image carries several sequential captions.

Very dark green field. The top row is split in three: postal address in small sans at left, the section menu as a column of serif links at about 24px starting at the centre line, and social links right-aligned at the far right. The wordmark repeats at full width along the bottom edge at hero size, caught rising letter by letter. Tiny credits sit beneath.

steal: Anchor the name at full width on the bottom edge of a full-bleed video and tuck two tiny descriptor pairs above its left and right ends.
Pin one photograph and cycle one-word captions over it instead of building a card for each value.
Place a small facts stack (elevation, temperature, live local time) beside a flat map to ground a destination.

references.name: Realevate
references.idea: The site is a board you zoom out of: the home screen with its slogan marquee becomes one tile beneath four tall colour-coded category cards.
references.hero: White field, all type navy. Top row about 8% down: one link far left, an extended-caps wordmark centred, one link far right. Across the vertical middle a two-word slogan repeats as a marquee at about 15vw in medium weight, cropped by both edges; a square photograph about 19vw wide sits dead centre on top of it, hiding the letters behind. Lower third: a two-line centred subhead near 24px and, beneath it, a thin-outlined rectangular tag in tiny extended capitals. Bottom-left a copyright line; bottom-right an outlined rectangular button beside a solid navy square menu button.
references.type: Google Sans medium at 218px with -0.02em tracking for the marquee and roughly 16-24px for interface text. Monument Extended in small spaced capitals for the wordmark and price tag. Card titles are rotated 90 degrees and read bottom to top.
references.colour: #ffffff #1e2a5e #e1e2ea #3a664f #2c1a2e #1c1b1e — Navy on white with no other interface colour in the hero. The overview sits on pale lavender-grey and gives each category a flat card colour: navy, forest green, aubergine, near-black.
references.imagery: Glossy architectural renders of sea-view terraces, resorts and towers. One perfect square in the hero; landscape crops fill the bottom third of each category card. Square corners, full saturation, no grade.
references.layout: A one-screen site with two states. Home is symmetrical: corners hold small utilities, the centre holds marquee and image. The overview is a four-column row of tall cards with equal gutters and a scaled-down live copy of the home screen centred beneath.

sections.description: Pale lavender-grey ground with four equal portrait cards in a row, roughly 1:2 in proportion, about 20px apart with generous outer margins. Each card is a flat colour block for its top 70% and a photograph for the bottom 30%. A small monogram sits top-left; the category name runs vertically up the right side in white at about 28px; a two-line descriptor in tiny white text sits bottom-left of the colour block, just above the image.

Centred below the card row, spanning the middle two columns, sits a miniature of the home screen: a white rectangle with the tiny nav row, the slogan marquee still running and the square photo in the middle, cropped by the viewport's bottom edge. It acts as a live thumbnail of where the visitor came from and a way back.

steal: Run a giant slogan marquee through the middle of the viewport and park a square image on top so the words are read as they pass around the picture.
Build category cards as a tall colour block over a short photo, with the title rotated up the right edge.
Keep utilities in the four corners (two links top, copyright bottom-left, action pair bottom-right) and leave the sides empty.
